subject: AI 与科技日报 2026-11-09 · Daily AI & Tech Brief
headline_zh: 英伟达调查黄仁勋与疑似中国间谍关系；埃及列车相撞致7死逾百伤；新西兰大选无多数党
headline_en: Nvidia probes Jensen Huang's ties to alleged Chinese spy; Egypt train crash kills 7; New Zealand election yields no clear winner

items.title_zh: 英伟达董事会调查黄仁勋与疑似中国间谍的关系
items.title_en: Nvidia board investigates Jensen Huang's ties to alleged Chinese spy
items.body_zh: 英伟达董事会周日宣布启动独立调查，审查CEO黄仁勋与Megaspeed高管Alice Huang的关系。据The Verge报道，Alice Huang被指由中国国家安全部招募，用于刺探英伟达情报。黄仁勋在致员工的备忘录中承认了这段婚外情。
items.body_en: Nvidia's board said Sunday it has opened an independent investigation into CEO Jensen Huang's relationship with Alice Huang, an executive at Megaspeed who was reportedly recruited by China's Ministry of State Security to spy on the company. Huang acknowledged the affair in a memo to staff.

items.title_zh: 高盛据报撤下银行家和交易员使用的Claude Code
items.title_en: Goldman Sachs reportedly pulls Claude Code from bankers and traders
items.body_zh: 据The State of AI报道，高盛已停止让银行家和交易员使用Anthropic的Claude Code。此举显示华尔街对AI编程工具在合规与数据安全上的顾虑正在上升。
items.body_en: Goldman Sachs has pulled Anthropic's Claude Code from its bankers and traders, according to The State of AI. The move signals growing Wall Street caution over compliance and data-security risks in AI coding tools.

items.title_zh: 苹果CEO施压软件主管加快Siri智能体路线图
items.title_en: Apple CEO presses software chief to accelerate agentic Siri
items.body_zh: 彭博的Mark Gurman称，苹果CEO John Ternus正敦促AI负责人Craig Federighi加快Siri路线图，打造能与OpenAI Dots或Meta Muse竞争的AI智能体。苹果已在极短时间内交付了可用版Siri AI，但内部对差距并无幻想。
items.body_en: Bloomberg's Mark Gurman reports that Apple CEO John Ternus is pressing AI chief Craig Federighi to speed up the Siri roadmap and deliver an AI agent that can compete with OpenAI's Dots or Meta's Muse. Apple has shipped a working Siri AI on a very short timeline, but internally has no illusions about the gap.

items.title_zh: 英国公共机构遭遇聊天机器人投诉潮
items.title_en: UK public bodies swamped by chatbot-generated complaints
items.body_zh: 据《卫报》报道，英国多家公共机构正疲于应对由AI聊天机器人批量生成的投诉，形成所谓“AI堵塞”。这类低成本投诉正在挤占本已紧张的处理资源。
items.body_en: UK public bodies are struggling with a surge of complaints mass-generated by AI chatbots, in what The Guardian calls an 'AI clog.' The low-cost complaints are straining already stretched processing resources.

items.title_zh: 研究：使用AI的员工每天实际工作时间更长
items.title_en: Study: employees using AI end up working more hours per day
items.body_zh: 据Futurism报道，一项研究发现使用AI工具的员工每天实际投入的工作时间反而大幅增加。这与“AI省时”的普遍预期形成反差，值得企业重新审视效率叙事。
items.body_en: Employees who use AI tools end up working vastly more time per day, according to a study cited by Futurism. The finding cuts against the common 'AI saves time' narrative and merits a rethink of corporate efficiency claims.

items.title_en: Epic Games Launcher is coming to SteamOS
items.body_zh: Epic传播总监Jake Jones确认，Epic游戏启动器将兼容Valve基于Linux的SteamOS。此前Epic仅表示在“调查”《堡垒之夜》的兼容性，如今正式落地。
items.body_en: Epic communications director Jake Jones confirmed the Epic Games Launcher will support Valve's Linux-based SteamOS. Epic had previously said only that it was 'investigating' Fortnite compatibility; now it's official.

items.title_zh: 埃及两列火车相撞致7死逾百伤
items.title_en: Two trains collide in Egypt, killing 7 and injuring over 100
items.body_zh: 周日，埃及吉萨省al-Ayyat地区两列同向行驶的火车相撞，多节车厢脱轨，造成至少7人死亡、100多人受伤。埃及总统已下令迅速调查。各家媒体对伤亡数字的报道略有出入，最高为125人受伤。
items.body_en: Two trains travelling in the same direction collided in al-Ayyat, Giza province, south of Cairo, on Sunday, derailing several carriages and killing at least seven people and injuring more than 100. Egypt's president ordered a prompt investigation; injury counts vary slightly across outlets, with some reporting up to 125.

items.title_zh: 新西兰大选无明确赢家，组阁谈判或持续数周
items.title_en: No clear winner in New Zealand election as coalition talks loom
items.body_zh: 新西兰大选结果胶着，两大主要政党均未取得多数，领导人准备展开数周谈判。据BBC报道，选民情绪“平淡、疲惫、愤世嫉俗”，对政治的信任跌至低点。
items.body_en: New Zealand's election produced no clear winner, with both major parties short of a majority and leaders preparing for weeks of talks. The BBC describes an unusually gloomy mood — 'flat,' 'tired,' 'cynical' — with faith in politics at a low.

items.title_zh: 以色列总统授权埃森科特组阁
items.title_en: Israel's president taps Eisenkot to form government
items.body_zh: 以色列总统正式授权反对派人物加迪·埃森科特组建新政府，而非内塔尼亚胡。据半岛电视台报道，埃森科特表示对让内塔尼亚胡加入下一届政府持开放态度。
items.body_en: Israel's president formally tasked opposition figure Gadi Eisenkot, not Benjamin Netanyahu, with forming a new government. Eisenkot is open to Netanyahu joining the next coalition, Al Jazeera reports.

quick_zh: 波兰克拉科夫枪击案致6人死亡，检方以恐怖主义方向立案调查。
沙特称拦截至少四枚胡塞武装导弹，利雅得阿美大厦受损；胡塞方面称萨那周边空袭致至少33人死亡。
中国成功发射卫星互联网低轨29组卫星。
quick_en: A mass shooting in Krakow, Poland, killed six people; prosecutors have opened a terrorism probe.
Saudi Arabia says it intercepted at least four Houthi missiles and an Aramco tower in Riyadh was damaged; the Houthis say Saudi strikes near Sanaa killed at least 33.
China successfully launched the 29th batch of satellites for its low-orbit internet constellation.
